hero.title: About College Events
hero.tagline: More than events. It's where campus life comes alive.
hero.description: College Events is your central platform for discovering everything happening across our campus. Whether you want to learn new technical skills, showcase your talent on stage, compete in sports tournaments, or connect with peers, this platform brings every opportunity directly to you.

paragraphs.paragraph: College is filled with energy, talent, and constant activity. On any given week, workshops, coding competitions, cultural rehearsals, sports matches, and expert seminars are taking place across various departments.

However, with notices scattered across different boards, departmental groups, and messaging chats, students often miss out on exciting opportunities simply because they didn't hear about them in time.
College Events bridges this gap by bringing every single campus activity into one clear, organized place—ensuring you never miss an opportunity to participate, learn, or celebrate.

banner.title: No More Missed Opportunities
banner.description: One unified schedule for all clubs, departments, and sports committees.

experiences.title: Discover More Than Just Events
experiences.subtitle: Find experiences tailored to your passions and interests

card.title: Learn
card.description: Discover hands-on workshops, technical bootcamps, and guest lectures to gain valuable skills beyond the classroom curriculum.

card.title: Compete
card.description: Challenge yourself in coding hackathons, debate tournaments, gaming showdowns, and inter-college sports competitions.

card.title: Create
card.description: Express your creative spirit through music festivals, dance performances, drama, art exhibitions, and photography showcases.

card.title: Connect
card.description: Meet students from other departments, join passionate club communities, and build lifelong memories during your college years.

convenience.title: Everything You Need, In One Spot
convenience.description: We've eliminated complicated registration processes so you can focus on being part of the action.

step.title: Discover Easily
step.description: Filter activities by technical, cultural, sports, or workshop categories with up-to-date details.

step.title: Get All Info
step.description: Check dates, precise campus venues, timing, schedules, rules, and remaining available seats.

step.title: Instant Registration
step.description: Reserve your spot online in seconds and receive your digital confirmation pass right away.

step.title: Manage Easily
step.description: Keep track of all your upcoming participation passes in your personal "My Registrations" dashboard.

quote.description: Academic lectures give you knowledge, but campus activities build character, confidence, and community. Take part, cheer for your friends, learn something unexpected, and make your college journey unforgettable.

memories.title: Moments That Become Memories
memories.subtitle: College is not only about where you go. It's about what you experience along the way.

slide.title: The First Time You Step on Stage

slide.title: The Team You Didn't Know You'd Meet

slide.title: The Competition You Almost Didn't Enter
slide.description: Sometimes the experiences you almost skip become the ones you remember the longest.

slide.title: The Workshop That Sparks Something New
slide.description: One new idea, skill, or conversation can change the way you see what you're capable of.

slide.title: The Evening Everyone Remembers
